free_text: Biopsy is recommended because the PI-RADS score of 4 strongly indicates a high-risk lesion, which aligns with the cohort criterion that has been validated in this exact situation. This decision is supported by the objective anatomical finding of a focal area spanning 12 x 9 x 8 mm described in the MRI report. The evidence converged on biopsy due to the high PI-RADS score and the established protocol for this finding.
